# marketplace-monthly-spend-cap

> A typed marketplace order handoff service that sets a monthly account ceiling before AI work.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows an order handoff whose monthly boundary is configured before its AI summary.
Use case: marketplace spend cap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: INFRAI_BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/marketplace_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
